findings: RT3-001 (HIGH): EventLog::verify() had zero production callers; a tampered events.jsonl was undetectable
RT3-002 (MEDIUM): persist_events was a non-atomic full rewrite; a crash mid-write destroyed the log
notes: RT3-001: added EventLog::from_records (verifies on construction from disk bytes) + load_event_log in driver (missing file -> fresh log; present file -> parse + verify, typed DriverError::Record naming the file on failure); run() now loads via load_event_log before first append. RT3-002: persist_events is now tmp+rename atomic (same protocol as verdict receipts) and refuses to persist a broken chain. Trust statement documented at both choke points: chain detects tampering, does not authenticate the writer (dead-drop limitation). Scope kept: event-log module + persist_events + call sites only.
